about: Where the data of each program for the pages inside/, map/ and about/ is (written by tools/map-data/). An empty value: in inside/data/<name>/ of this site. A URL ending in /: the folder that holds writer.json, engine.json, tiles.json, tiles/ and the rest, on a host that allows other sites to read it. A program whose data is nowhere gets a message instead of a map; the other programs keep working. On a hosted site the folders data/<name>/deep/ can be left out: they are only used when the program text cannot be read in parts.
